rows.text_en: Ministry of Gender Equality and Family ( Family Support Division ), 02-2100-6343, 6351

rows.source_ko: 제1조(목적) 이 규칙은 「한부모가족지원법」 및 같은 법 시행령에서 위임된 사항과 그 시행에 필요한 사항을 규정함을 목적으로 한다. <개정 2003. 7. 9., 2006. 5. 12., 2008. 1. 15.>
rows.text_en: Article 1 (Purpose) The purpose of this Rule is to prescribe matters delegated by the Single-Parent Family Support Act and its Enforcement Decree , as well as matters necessary for its implementation. <Amended July 9, 2003; May 12, 2006; Jan. 15, 2008>

Article 2 (Scope of Mothers and Fathers) In Article 4, Subparagraph 1, Item (e) of the Single-Parent Family Support Act (hereinafter referred to as the “Act”) , the term “person prescribed by the Ordinance of the Ministry for Gender Equality and Family” refers to any person falling under any of the following subparagraphs. <Amended Jan. 17, 1996; Jul. 9, 2003; Jun. 23, 2005; May 12, 2006; Jan. 15, 2008; Mar. 3, 2008; Mar. 19, 2010; Aug. 2, 2012; Oct. 1, 2025>

rows.source_ko: 1. 배우자의 생사가 분명하지 아니한 자
rows.text_en: 1. A person whose spouse's life or death cannot be determined

rows.source_ko: 2. 배우자 또는 배우자 가족과의 불화등으로 인하여 가출한 자
rows.text_en: 2. A person who has run away from home due to discord with their spouse or spouse's family, etc.
3. Deleted <August 2, 2012>
[Title amended July 9, 2003]

rows.source_ko: 제3조(지원대상자의 범위) 법 제5조 및 제5조의2제2항에 따른 지원대상자의 범위는 성평등가족부장관이 매년 「국민기초생활 보장법」 제2조제11호에 따른 기준 중위소득, 지원대상자의 소득수준 및 재산의 정도 등을 고려하여 지원의 종류별로 정하여 고시한다. <개정 2014. 7. 22., 2015. 12. 14., 2025. 10. 1.>
rows.text_en: Article 3 (Scope of Beneficiaries) The scope of beneficiaries pursuant to Article 5 and Article 5-2 , Paragraph 2 of the Act shall be determined annually by the Minister of Gender Equality and Family for each type of support, taking into consideration the standard median income under Subparagraph 11 of Article 2 of the National Basic Living Security Act , the income level and extent of assets of the beneficiaries, etc., and shall be announced by public notice. <Amended July 22, 2014; December 14, 2015; October 1, 2025>

[Wholly Amended June 29, 2012]
[Title Amended July 22, 2014]

rows.source_ko: 제3조의2(지원대상자의 범위에 대한 특례) 법 제5조의2제2항제5호에서 “성평등가족부령으로 정하는 아동”이란 다음 각 호의 어느 하나에 해당하는 아동을 말한다. <개정 2008. 12. 31., 2010. 3. 19., 2012. 1. 2., 2025. 10. 1.>
rows.text_en: Article 3-2 (Special Provisions on the Scope of Persons Eligible for Support) In Article 5-2, Paragraph 2, Subparagraph 5 of the Act , the term “child prescribed by the Ordinance of the Ministry for Gender Equality and Family” refers to a child falling under any of the following subparagraphs. <Amended Dec. 31, 2008; Mar. 19, 2010; Jan. 2, 2012; Oct. 1, 2025>
1. Deleted <January 2, 2012>

rows.source_ko: 2. 부모가 가정의 불화 등으로 가출하여 부모의 부양을 받을 수 없는 아동
rows.text_en: 2. Children who cannot receive support from their parents because the parents have run away due to family discord, etc.

rows.source_ko: 3. 그 밖에 부모가 실직 등으로 장기간 경제적 능력을 상실하여 부양을 받을 수 없는 아동
rows.text_en: 3. Other children who cannot receive support because their parents have lost their economic ability for a long period due to unemployment, etc.

[This Article was newly established on Jan. 15, 2008.]
[Title amended on Jul. 22, 2014.]

rows.source_ko: 제3조의3(한부모가족증명서의 발급) ①제3조에 따른 지원대상자, 그 친권자 또는 후견인 등이 한부모가족증명서를 발급받으려는 경우에는 별지 제1호서식의 한부모가족증명서 발급신청서 또는 다음 각 호의 어느 하나에 해당하는 신분증명서(지원대상자만 해당한다)를 특별자치시장ㆍ특별자치도지사ㆍ시장ㆍ군수ㆍ구청장(자치구의 구청장을 말한다. 이하 같다)에게 제출하여야 한다. 다만, 제3조에 따른 지원대상자는 정보통신망이나 무인(無人)민원발급기에서 한부모가족증명서를 직접 발급받을 수 있다. <개정 2012. 1. 2., 2014. 7. 22., 2020. 11. 6.>
rows.text_en: Article 3-3 (Issuance of Certificate of Single-Parent Family) ① If a person eligible for support under Article 3 , their legal guardian, or guardian, etc., intends to obtain a Certificate of Single-Parent Family, they shall submit an application for the issuance of a Certificate of Single-Parent Family in the form of Attached Form No. 1 or an identification document falling under any of the following subparagraphs (applicable only to persons eligible for support) to the Mayor of a Special Self-Governing City, the Governor of a Special Self-Governing Province, a Mayor, a County Head, or a District Head (referring to the head of a self-governing district; hereinafter the same applies). However, persons eligible for support under Article 3 may obtain a Certificate of Single-Parent Family directly through an information and communications network or an unmanned civil service issuance machine. <Amended Jan. 2, 2012; July 22, 2014; Nov. 6, 2020>

rows.source_ko: 1. 「주민등록법」에 따른 주민등록증
rows.text_en: 1. Resident registration card pursuant to the Resident Registration Act

rows.source_ko: 2. 「여권법」에 따른 여권
rows.text_en: 2. Passport pursuant to the Passport Act

rows.source_ko: 3. 「도로교통법」에 따른 자동차 운전면허증
rows.text_en: 3. Driver's license pursuant to the Road Traffic Act

rows.source_ko: 4. 「출입국관리법」에 따른 외국인등록증
rows.text_en: 4. Alien Registration Card pursuant to the Immigration Control Act

rows.source_ko: ② 제1항에 따라 신청을 받은 특별자치시장ㆍ특별자치도지사ㆍ시장ㆍ군수ㆍ구청장은 별지 제2호서식의 한부모가족증명서를 신청인에게 발급하여야 한다. <신설 2014. 7. 22.>
rows.text_en: ② The Mayor of a Special Self-Governing City, the Governor of a Special Self-Governing Province, a Mayor, a County Governor, or a District Head who receives an application pursuant to Paragraph 1 shall issue a Certificate of Single-Parent Family in the form of Attached Form No. 2 to the applicant. <Newly added July 22, 2014>

[Wholly Amended Mar. 30, 2011]
[Moved from Article 9-2 <Jan. 2, 2012>]

rows.source_ko: 제4조(실태조사의 대상 및 방법 등) ① 법 제6조제1항에 따른 실태조사는 한부모가족이 된 사유와 형태를 고려한 대표성 있는 조사대상을 선정하여 실시하며, 다음 각 호의 사항에 관한 조사가 포함되어야 한다. <개정 2025. 10. 1.>
rows.text_en: Article 4 (Subjects and Methods of Fact-Finding Survey, etc.) ① The fact-finding survey under Article 6, Paragraph 1 of the Act shall be conducted by selecting representative subjects that take into consideration the reasons and forms of becoming a single-parent family, and shall include an investigation into the matters of each of the following subparagraphs. <Amended Oct. 1, 2025>

rows.source_ko: 1. 가구주의 성별, 나이, 학력, 혼인상태, 장애여부, 거주지역 등 신상에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 1. Personal details of the head of household, such as gender, age, education level, marital status, disability status, and place of residence

rows.source_ko: 2. 가구주의 이혼, 사별, 미혼, 출산 등 한부모가족이 된 사유에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 2. Matters concerning the reason for the head of household becoming a single-parent family, such as divorce, death of a spouse, being unmarried, or childbirth.

rows.source_ko: 3. 자녀 수, 가족 부양자, 자녀양육비 부담자 등 가족 관계 및 그 부양에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 3. Matters concerning family relationships and support, such as the number of children, family supporters, and those responsible for child-rearing expenses

rows.source_ko: 4. 주거 상태, 소비 수준, 여가 활용행태, 정보 이용 등 생활양식에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 4. Matters concerning lifestyle, such as housing conditions, consumption levels, leisure usage patterns, and information usage

rows.source_ko: 5. 취업 및 소득 등 경제 상태에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 5. Matters concerning economic status, such as employment and income

rows.source_ko: 6. 한부모가족 관련 지원 수요에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 6. Matters concerning the demand for support related to single-parent families

rows.source_ko: 7. 그 밖에 성평등가족부장관이 한부모가족 지원정책의 수립을 위하여 필요하다고 인정하는 사항
rows.text_en: 7. Other matters deemed necessary by the Minister of Gender Equality and Family for the establishment of support policies for single-parent families

rows.source_ko: ② 성평등가족부장관은 법 제6조제1항에 따른 실태조사 및 연구를 가족복지에 관한 전문성과 인력을 갖춘 대학, 연구기관, 법인 또는 단체에 의뢰하여 실시할 수 있다. <개정 2018. 6. 12., 2025. 10. 1.>
rows.text_en: ② The Minister of Gender Equality and Family may commission fact-finding surveys and research pursuant to Article 6 , Paragraph 1 of the Act to universities, research institutions, corporations, or organizations equipped with expertise and personnel in family welfare. <Amended Jun. 12, 2018; Oct. 1, 2025>

[This Article was newly added on Jan. 2, 2012.]
[Former Article 4 was moved to Article 9-4 <Jan. 2, 2012>]

rows.source_ko: 제5조(지원대상 한부모가족의 조사보고 등) ①법 제10조제3항에 따라 특별자치시장ㆍ특별자치도지사ㆍ시장ㆍ군수ㆍ구청장은 관할구역안의 지원대상자의 실태에 관하여 다음 각 호의 사항을 조사하고 이를 복지대상자 통합관리카드에 기록ㆍ관리하여야 한다. <개정 1999. 10. 1., 2000. 9. 30., 2003. 7. 9., 2007. 3. 29., 2008. 1. 15., 2009. 12. 31., 2010. 8. 17., 2012. 1. 2., 2014. 7. 22.>
rows.text_en: Article 5 (Investigation and Reporting of Single-Parent Families Eligible for Support, etc.) ① Pursuant to Article 10, Paragraph 3 of the Act , the Mayor of a Special Self-Governing City, the Governor of a Special Self-Governing Province, a Mayor, a County Head, or a District Head shall investigate the matters set forth in each of the following subparagraphs regarding the actual status of persons eligible for support within their jurisdictions and record and manage them in the Integrated Management Card for Welfare Recipients. <Amended Oct. 1, 1999; Sep. 30, 2000; Jul. 9, 2003; Mar. 29, 2007; Jan. 15, 2008; Dec. 31, 2009; Aug. 17, 2010; Jan. 2, 2012; Jul. 22, 2014>

rows.source_ko: 1. 가족상황
rows.text_en: 1. Family situation

rows.source_ko: 2. 소득 및 자산보유상황 등 생활상태
rows.text_en: 2. Living conditions, including income and asset ownership

rows.source_ko: 3. 부양의무자가 있으면 그 부양능력의 유무
rows.text_en: 3. If there is a person with a duty of support, whether or not they have the ability to provide support

rows.source_ko: 4. 그 밖에 지원실시에 필요한 사항
rows.text_en: 4. Other matters necessary for the implementation of support

rows.source_ko: ②특별자치시장ㆍ특별자치도지사ㆍ시장ㆍ군수ㆍ구청장은 제1항에 따라 조사된 복지대상자 통합관리카드를 기초로 하여 지원대상 한부모가족 현황을 매년 12월 31일 현재로 작성하여 다음해 1월 20일까지 특별시장ㆍ광역시장ㆍ특별자치시장ㆍ도지사 또는 특별자치도지사(이하 “시ㆍ도지사”라 한다)에게 보고하여야 하며, 시ㆍ도지사는 이를 1월 31일까지 성평등가족부장관에게 보고하여야 한다. 다만, 특별자치시ㆍ특별자치도의 경우에는 특별자치시장ㆍ특별자치도지사가 1월 31일까지 직접 성평등가족부장관에게 보고하여야 한다. <개정 1996. 1. 17., 2000. 9. 30., 2003. 7. 9., 2005. 6. 23., 2008. 1. 15., 2008. 3. 3., 2010. 3. 19., 2010. 8. 17., 2014. 7. 22., 2025. 10. 1.>
rows.text_en: ② The Mayor of a Special Self-Governing City, the Governor of a Special Self-Governing Province, a Mayor, a County Head, or a District Head shall prepare a report on the status of single-parent families eligible for support as of December 31 of each year, based on the integrated management card of welfare recipients investigated pursuant to Paragraph 1, and report it to the Mayor of a Special City, Metropolitan City, the Mayor of a Special Self-Governing City, the Governor of a Province, or the Governor of a Special Self-Governing Province (hereinafter referred to as “Mayor/Governor of a City/Province”) by January 20 of the following year, and the Mayor/Governor of a City/Province shall report this to the Minister of Gender Equality and Family by January 31. However, in the case of a Special Self-Governing City or a Special Self-Governing Province, the Mayor of the Special Self-Governing City or the Governor of the Special Self-Governing Province shall report it directly to the Minister of Gender Equality and Family by January 31. <Amended Jan. 17, 1996; Sep. 30, 2000; Jul. 9, 2003; Jun. 23, 2005; Jan. 15, 2008; Mar. 3, 2008; Mar. 19, 2010; Aug. 17, 2010; Jul. 22, 2014; Oct. 1, 2025>

[Title amended July 22, 2014]
[Moved from Article 6 <Jan 2, 2012>]

rows.source_ko: 제6조(복지 급여의 지급기준) 법 제12조에 따른 복지 급여의 기준은 성평등가족부장관이 매년 지원대상자의 급여 수준, 지원대상자의 수, 물가 수준 및 예산 등을 종합적으로 고려하여 정하고 이를 고시하여야 한다. <개정 2014. 7. 22., 2025. 10. 1.>
rows.text_en: Article 6 (Standards for Payment of Welfare Benefits) The standards for welfare benefits pursuant to Article 12 of the Act shall be determined annually by the Minister of Gender Equality and Family, taking into comprehensive consideration the benefit levels of eligible recipients, the number of eligible recipients, price levels, and the budget, and shall be publicly notified thereof . <Amended July 22, 2014; October 1, 2025>

[This Article was newly added on Jan. 2, 2012.]
[Former Article 6 was moved to Article 5 <Jan. 2, 2012>]

rows.source_ko: 제7조(복지급여수급계좌 입금 신청서) 「한부모가족지원법 시행령」(이하 “영”이라 한다) 제14조의2제1항에 따른 복지급여수급계좌 입금 신청서는 별지 제3호서식에 따른다.
rows.text_en: Article 7 (Application for Deposit into Welfare Benefit Recipient Account) The application for deposit into a welfare benefit recipient account pursuant to Article 14-2, Paragraph 1 of the Enforcement Decree of the Single-Parent Family Support Act (hereinafter referred to as the “Decree”) shall be in accordance with Form No. 3 attached hereto .
[This Article Newly Inserted July 22, 2014]

rows.source_ko: 제8조(복지 자금의 대여신청 등) ①영 제16조제1항에 따른 복지자금대여신청서는 거주지관할 읍ㆍ면ㆍ동장을 거쳐 특별자치시장ㆍ특별자치도지사ㆍ시장ㆍ군수ㆍ구청장에게 제출하여야 한다. <개정 2000. 9. 30., 2003. 7. 9., 2006. 5. 12., 2008. 1. 15., 2010. 8. 17., 2014. 7. 22.>
rows.text_en: Article 8 (Application for Loan of Welfare Funds, etc.) ① An application for a loan of welfare funds pursuant to Article 16, Paragraph 1 of the Enforcement Decree shall be submitted to the Mayor of a Special Self-Governing City, the Governor of a Special Self-Governing Province, a Mayor, a County Head, or a District Head through the head of the Eup, Myeon, or Dong having jurisdiction over the place of residence. <Amended Sep. 30, 2000; Jul. 9, 2003; May 12, 2006; Jan. 15, 2008; Aug. 17, 2010; Jul. 22, 2014>

rows.source_ko: ②제1항에 따른 복지자금대여신청서에 첨부할 서류는 다음 각 호와 같다. <개정 2008. 1. 15.>
rows.text_en: ② The documents to be attached to the application for a welfare fund loan pursuant to Paragraph 1 are as follows: <Amended Jan. 15, 2008>

rows.source_ko: 1. 사업에 필요한 자금 : 사업의 종류, 사업장의 소재지 및 사업의 내용등을 기재한 사업계획서
rows.text_en: 1. Funds required for the business: A business plan specifying the type of business, location of the business, and details of the business.

rows.source_ko: 2. 아동교육비 : 재학증명서
rows.text_en: 2. Child Education Expenses: Certificate of Enrollment

rows.source_ko: 3. 의료비 : 의사의 진단서
rows.text_en: 3. Medical expenses: Doctor's diagnosis

rows.source_ko: 4. 주택자금:매매ㆍ전세 또는 임대차계약서사본
rows.text_en: 4. Housing Funds: Copy of Sale, Jeonse, or Lease Agreement

rows.source_ko: ③제1항에 따른 신청을 받은 특별자치시장ㆍ특별자치도지사ㆍ시장ㆍ군수ㆍ구청장은 신청인을 복지 자금대여자로 결정하면 그에게 복지대상자자금대여결정통지서를 송부하여야 한다. <신설 1996. 1. 17., 2000. 9. 30., 2008. 1. 15., 2009. 12. 31., 2010. 8. 17., 2014. 7. 22.>
rows.text_en: ③ The Mayor of a Special Self-Governing City, the Governor of a Special Self-Governing Province, a Mayor, a County Head, or a District Head who has received an application pursuant to Paragraph 1 shall, upon determining the applicant to be a welfare fund loan recipient, send a Notice of Decision on Loan to Welfare Beneficiary to that applicant. <Newly added Jan. 17, 1996; Sep. 30, 2000; Jan. 15, 2008; Dec. 31, 2009; Aug. 17, 2010; Jul. 22, 2014>
[Title amended Jan. 15, 2008]

rows.source_ko: 제9조(복지자금대여 관리카드) 영 제17조제2항에 따른 복지 자금대여 내용과 상환내역 등은 복지대상자 자금대여 관리카드에 기록ㆍ관리한다. <개정 2000. 9. 30., 2008. 1. 15., 2009. 12. 31., 2014. 7. 22.>
rows.text_en: Article 9 (Welfare Fund Loan Management Card) Details of welfare fund loans and repayment records, etc., pursuant to Article 17, Paragraph 2 of the Enforcement Decree shall be recorded and managed in the Welfare Beneficiary Loan Management Card. <Amended Sep. 30, 2000; Jan. 15, 2008; Dec. 31, 2009; Jul. 22, 2014>

rows.source_ko: 제9조의2(청소년 한부모에 대한 교육 지원) 법 제17조의2제1항제4호에서 “성평등가족부령으로 정하는 사항”이란 청소년 한부모가 학업을 하는 기간 중 해당 청소년 한부모가 양육하고 있는 자녀를 돌보는 내용의 지원을 말한다. <개정 2025. 10. 1.>
rows.text_en: Article 9-2 (Educational Support for Adolescent Single Parents) In Article 17-2, Paragraph 1, Subparagraph 4 of the Act , the term “matters prescribed by the Ordinance of the Ministry for Gender Equality and Family” refers to support involving the care of children being raised by an adolescent single parent during the period of their studies. <Amended Oct. 1, 2025>

[This Article was newly inserted on Jan. 2, 2012.]
[Formerly Article 9-2 was moved to Article 3-3 <Jan. 2, 2012>]

rows.source_ko: 제9조의3(청소년 한부모 자립지원의 신청 및 방법) ① 법 제17조의4제1항에 따라 자산형성을 위한 재정적인 지원을 받으려는 청소년 한부모는 복지 급여 신청서(전자문서로 된 신청서를 포함한다)에 다음 각 호의 서류(전자문서를 포함한다)를 첨부하여 관할 특별자치시장ㆍ특별자치도지사ㆍ시장ㆍ군수ㆍ구청장에게 제출하여야 한다.
rows.text_en: Article 9-3 (Application and Method for Self-Reliance Support for Youth Single Parents) ① A youth single parent who wishes to receive financial support for asset formation pursuant to Article 17-4, Paragraph 1 of the Act shall submit a welfare benefit application form (including an application form in electronic form) to the competent Special Self-Governing City Mayor, Special Self-Governing Province Governor, Mayor, County Governor, or District Head, attaching the documents (including electronic documents) of each of the following subparagraphs.

rows.source_ko: 1. 소득ㆍ재산 신고서
rows.text_en: 1. Income and Asset Declaration Form

rows.source_ko: 2. 금융정보등의 제공 동의서
rows.text_en: 2. Consent Form for Provision of Financial Information, etc.

rows.source_ko: 3. 배우자의 건강진단서(신청인이 법 제4조제1호나목에 해당하는 경우로 한정한다)
rows.text_en: 3. Health certificate of the spouse ( limited to cases where the applicant falls under Article 4, Subparagraph 1, Item B of the Act )

rows.source_ko: ② 제1항에 따른 신청을 받은 특별자치시장ㆍ특별자치도지사ㆍ시장ㆍ군수ㆍ구청장은 「전자정부법」 제36조제1항에 따른 행정정보의 공동이용을 통하여 신청인의 가족관계기록사항에 관한 증명서의 내용을 확인하여야 한다. 다만, 신청인이 확인에 동의하지 아니하면 해당 서류를 첨부하도록 하여야 한다.
rows.text_en: ② The Mayor of a Special Self-Governing City, the Governor of a Special Self-Governing Province, a Mayor, a County Governor, or a District Head who receives an application under Paragraph 1 shall verify the contents of the certificate regarding the applicant’s family relationship records through the joint use of administrative information pursuant to Article 36, Paragraph 1 of the Electronic Government Act . However, if the applicant does not consent to the verification, they shall be required to attach the relevant documents.

rows.source_ko: ③ 제1항에 따른 신청을 받은 특별자치시장ㆍ특별자치도지사ㆍ시장ㆍ군수ㆍ구청장은 신청을 받은 날부터 14일 이내에 청소년 한부모 자립지원 여부를 결정하고, 그 결과를 신청인에게 통지하여야 한다.
rows.text_en: ③ The mayor of a special self-governing city, the governor of a special self-governing province, the mayor, the county head, or the district head who receives an application pursuant to Paragraph 1 shall decide whether to provide self-reliance support for adolescent single parents within 14 days from the date of receiving the application and notify the applicant of the result.

[This Article was newly added on July 22, 2014.]
[Formerly Article 9-3 was moved to Article 9-4 <July 22, 2014>]

rows.source_ko: 제9조의4(건강진단의 신청 절차 및 방법 등) ① 법 제17조의5에 따른 건강진단을 받으려는 청소년 한부모는 별지 제3호의2서식의 청소년 한부모 건강진단 신청서를 관할 특별자치시장ㆍ특별자치도지사ㆍ시장ㆍ군수ㆍ구청장에게 제출하여야 한다.
rows.text_en: Article 9-4 (Procedures and Methods for Applying for Health Examination, etc.) ① A youth single parent who wishes to receive a health examination pursuant to Article 17-5 of the Act shall submit the application for a youth single parent health examination in the form of Attached Form No. 3-2 to the competent Special Self-Governing City Mayor, Special Self-Governing Province Governor, Mayor, County Governor, or District Head.

rows.source_ko: ② 제1항에 따른 신청을 받은 특별자치시장ㆍ특별자치도지사ㆍ시장ㆍ군수ㆍ구청장은 신청을 받은 날부터 30일 이내에 건강진단의 실시 여부를 결정하여 신청인에게 통지하여야 한다.
rows.text_en: ② The mayor of a special self-governing city, the governor of a special self-governing province, the mayor, the county head, or the district head who receives an application pursuant to Paragraph 1 shall decide whether to conduct a health examination within 30 days from the date of receiving the application and notify the applicant.

rows.source_ko: ③ 특별자치시장ㆍ특별자치도지사ㆍ시장ㆍ군수ㆍ구청장은 제2항에 따라 건강진단 실시를 결정한 경우 신청인이 「건강검진기본법」 제14조에 따라 지정된 건강검진기관에서 건강진단을 원활하게 받을 수 있도록 건강진단 실시 비용 등을 지원한다.
rows.text_en: ③ When a mayor of a special self-governing city, a governor of a special self-governing province, a mayor, a county head, or a district head decides to conduct a health examination pursuant to Paragraph 2, they shall support the costs of conducting the health examination, etc., so that the applicant can receive the health examination smoothly at a health examination institution designated pursuant to Article 14 of the Basic Health Examination Act.

[This Article was newly added on June 12, 2018.]
[Formerly Article 9-4 was moved to Article 9-6 <June 12, 2018>]

rows.source_ko: 제9조의5(상담전화의 설치ㆍ운영 기준) ① 성평등가족부장관은 법 제18조의2제1항에 따른 한부모가족 상담전화를 운영할 때 전화 상담실을 별도로 갖추고, 행정전담인력과 상담원을 배치한다. <개정 2025. 10. 1.>
rows.text_en: Article 9-5 (Standards for Installation and Operation of Counseling Hotlines) ① When operating a counseling hotline for single-parent families pursuant to Article 18-2, Paragraph 1 of the Act, the Minister of Gender Equality and Family shall provide a separate telephone counseling room and assign dedicated administrative personnel and counselors. <Amended Oct. 1, 2025>

rows.source_ko: ② 성평등가족부장관은 한부모가족 상담전화 사무실에 다음 각 호에 해당하는 서류를 비치한다. <개정 2025. 10. 1.>
rows.text_en: ② The Minister of Gender Equality and Family shall keep the documents corresponding to each of the following subparagraphs at the single-parent family counseling hotline office. <Amended Oct. 1, 2025>

rows.source_ko: 1. 한부모가족지원정책 지침, 관련 기관 정보 등 한부모가족 상담에 필요한 정책 자료
rows.text_en: 1. Policy materials necessary for single-parent family counseling, such as single-parent family support policy guidelines and information on relevant agencies

rows.source_ko: 2. 한부모가족 상담전화 운영일지 및 상담일지
rows.text_en: 2. Single-Parent Family Counseling Hotline Operation Log and Counseling Log

rows.source_ko: 3. 그 밖에 회의록 등 성평등가족부장관이 정하는 서류
rows.text_en: 3. Other documents determined by the Minister of Gender Equality and Family, such as meeting minutes

[This Article was newly added on June 12, 2018.]
[Formerly Article 9-5 was moved to Article 9-7 <June 12, 2018>]

rows.source_ko: 제9조의6(복지시설의 입소ㆍ퇴소의 절차 및 기준) ① 법 제19조에 따른 한부모가족복지시설(이하 “한부모가족복지시설”이라 한다)에 입소하려는 사람은 입소 신청서를 입소하려는 한부모가족복지시설의 관할 특별자치시장ㆍ특별자치도지사ㆍ시장ㆍ군수ㆍ구청장에게 제출하여야 한다. <개정 2014. 7. 22.>
rows.text_en: Article 9-6 (Procedures and Standards for Admission and Discharge from Welfare Facilities) ① Any person who intends to be admitted to a single-parent family welfare facility pursuant to Article 19 of the Act (hereinafter referred to as “single-parent family welfare facility”) shall submit an application for admission to the Special Self-Governing City Mayor, Special Self-Governing Province Governor, Mayor, County Head, or District Head having jurisdiction over the single-parent family welfare facility where the person intends to be admitted. <Amended July 22, 2014>

rows.source_ko: ② 제1항에 따른 입소 신청을 받은 담당 공무원은 신청인(이미 한부모가족복지시설에 입소하고 있는 사람으로서 가족관계등록에 변동사항이 없는 사람은 제외한다)에 대한 가족관계기록사항에 관한 증명서의 내용을 「전자정부법」 제36조제1항에 따른 행정정보의 공동이용을 통하여 확인하여야 한다. 다만, 신청인이 확인에 동의하지 아니하는 경우에는 해당 서류를 첨부하도록 하여야 한다. <개정 2014. 7. 22.>
rows.text_en: ② The public official in charge who receives an application for admission pursuant to Paragraph 1 shall verify the contents of the certificate regarding family relationship records concerning the applicant (excluding persons already admitted to a single-parent family welfare facility who have no changes in their family relationship registration) through the joint use of administrative information pursuant to Article 36, Paragraph 1 of the Electronic Government Act . However, if the applicant does not consent to the verification, the applicant shall be required to attach the relevant documents. <Amended July 22, 2014>

rows.source_ko: ③ 제1항에 따라 입소 신청을 받은 특별자치시장ㆍ특별자치도지사ㆍ시장ㆍ군수ㆍ구청장은 신청을 받은 날부터 14일 이내에 입소 여부를 결정하여 신청인과 한부모가족복지시설의 장에게 통지하여야 한다. 다만, 한부모가족복지시설의 장은 신청인에 대한 긴급한 지원이 필요하다고 인정되는 경우에는 특별자치시장ㆍ특별자치도지사ㆍ시장ㆍ군수ㆍ구청장의 입소 결정 전까지 신청인을 임시로 입소시켜 지원할 수 있다. <개정 2014. 7. 22.>
rows.text_en: ③ The Mayor of a Special Self-Governing City, the Governor of a Special Self-Governing Province, a Mayor, a County Head, or a District Head who receives an application for admission pursuant to Paragraph 1 shall decide whether to admit the applicant within 14 days from the date of receipt of the application and notify the applicant and the head of the single-parent family welfare facility. However, if the head of the single-parent family welfare facility deems that urgent support for the applicant is necessary, they may temporarily admit the applicant and provide support until the Mayor of a Special Self-Governing City, the Governor of a Special Self-Governing Province, a Mayor, a County Head, or a District Head makes a decision on admission. <Amended July 22, 2014>

rows.source_ko: ④ 특별자치시장ㆍ특별자치도지사ㆍ시장ㆍ군수ㆍ구청장은 다음 각 호의 사유가 발생한 경우 한부모가족복지시설에서의 퇴소를 결정하여 해당 입소자 및 한부모가족복지시설의 장에게 통지하여야 한다. <개정 2012. 6. 29., 2014. 7. 22., 2018. 6. 12., 2021. 6. 28.>
rows.text_en: ④ The Mayor of a Special Self-Governing City, the Governor of a Special Self-Governing Province, a Mayor, a County Head, or a District Head shall decide on discharge from a single-parent family welfare facility and notify the relevant resident and the head of the single-parent family welfare facility in the event that any of the following causes occur. <Amended June 29, 2012; July 22, 2014; June 12, 2018; June 28, 2021>

rows.source_ko: 1. 제9조의7에서 정한 입소기간의 만료
rows.text_en: 1. Expiration of the admission period prescribed in Article 9-7

rows.source_ko: 2. 입소자가 거짓이나 그 밖의 부정한 방법으로 입소한 경우
rows.text_en: 2. In cases where a resident has been admitted through false or other fraudulent means

rows.source_ko: 3. 입소자 본인이 퇴소를 요청한 경우
rows.text_en: 3. Cases where the resident requests discharge

rows.source_ko: 4. 입소자가 한부모가족복지시설 안에서 아동학대, 마약 등의 약물 투여, 그 밖의 질서문란 행위를 하여 퇴소가 필요하다고 한부모가족복지시설의 장이 인정하여 요청한 경우
rows.text_en: 4. When the head of a single-parent family welfare facility requests the discharge of a resident who has committed child abuse, administered drugs such as narcotics, or committed other acts disrupting order within the facility, recognizing that discharge is necessary.

rows.source_ko: ⑤ 입소자가 퇴소한 경우 한부모가족복지시설의 장은 퇴소일로부터 3일 이내에 그 사실을 특별자치시장ㆍ특별자치도지사ㆍ시장ㆍ군수ㆍ구청장에게 보고하여야 한다. 이 경우 공휴일 및 토요일은 산입하지 아니한다. <개정 2014. 7. 22.>
rows.text_en: ⑤ In the event that a resident leaves the facility, the head of the single-parent family welfare facility shall report such fact to the Mayor of a Special Self-Governing City, the Governor of a Special Self-Governing Province, the Mayor, the County Governor, or the District Head within three days of the date of departure. In this case, public holidays and Saturdays shall not be included. <Amended July 22, 2014>

[This Article was newly added on Jan. 2, 2012]
[Moved from Article 9-4 <June 12, 2018>]

rows.source_ko: 제9조의7(입소기간) 법 제19조제2항에 따른 한부모가족복지시설에서의 입소기간, 입소기간의 연장사유 및 연장가능 기간은 별표 1과 같다. <개정 2014. 7. 22.>
rows.text_en: Article 9-7 (Period of Admission) The period of admission at single-parent family welfare facilities pursuant to Article 19, Paragraph 2 of the Act , the grounds for extension of the period of admission, and the period of extension are as set forth in Attached Table 1. <Amended July 22, 2014>

[Wholly Amended Jun. 29, 2012]
[Title Amended July 22, 2014]
[Moved from Article 9-5 <June 12, 2018>]

rows.source_ko: 제10조(한부모가족복지시설의 설치 신고 등) ①법 제20조제3항에 따른 한부모가족복지시설의 설치신고를 하려는 자는 별지 제4호서식의 한부모가족복지시설 설치신고서(전자문서로 된 신고서를 포함한다)에 다음 각 호의 서류(전자문서를 포함한다. 이하 같다)를 첨부하여 관할 특별자치시장ㆍ특별자치도지사ㆍ시장ㆍ군수ㆍ구청장에게 제출하여야 한다. <개정 2008. 1. 15., 2010. 8. 17., 2012. 1. 2., 2014. 7. 22.>
rows.text_en: Article 10 (Reporting of Establishment of Welfare Facilities for Single-Parent Families, etc.) ① Any person who intends to report the establishment of a welfare facility for single-parent families pursuant to Article 20, Paragraph 3 of the Act shall submit the Report on the Establishment of a Welfare Facility for Single-Parent Families in the form of Attached Form No. 4 (including a report in the form of an electronic document) to the competent Special Self-Governing City Mayor, Special Self-Governing Province Governor, Mayor, County Head, or District Head, attaching the documents set forth in each of the following subparagraphs (including electronic documents; hereinafter the same applies). <Amended Jan. 15, 2008; Aug. 17, 2010; Jan. 2, 2012; Jul. 22, 2014>

rows.source_ko: 1. 법인의 정관(법인인 경우에 한한다) 1부
rows.text_en: 1. One copy of the Articles of Incorporation of a corporation (limited to corporations)

rows.source_ko: 2. 시설운영에 필요한 재산목록(소유 또는 사용할 수 있는 권리를 증명할 수 있는 서류를 첨부하여야 한다. 이하 같다) 1부
rows.text_en: 2. One copy of the inventory of assets necessary for facility operation (documents proving ownership or the right to use must be attached; the same applies hereinafter).

rows.source_ko: 3. 사업계획서 및 예산서 각 1부
rows.text_en: 3. One copy each of the business plan and budget

rows.source_ko: 4. 시설의 평면도(시설의 층별 및 구조별 면적을 표시하여야 한다) 1부
rows.text_en: 4. One copy of the floor plan of the facility (must indicate the area by floor and structure of the facility).

rows.source_ko: ②제1항에 따라 신고서를 제출받은 담당공무원은 「전자정부법」 제36조제1항에 따른 행정정보의 공동이용을 통하여 법인 등기사항증명서(법인인 경우만 해당한다), 건축물대장을 확인하여야 한다. <개정 2008. 1. 15., 2010. 8. 17., 2014. 6. 19., 2014. 7. 22.>
rows.text_en: ② The public official in charge who receives the report pursuant to Paragraph 1 shall verify the Certificate of Corporate Registration (applicable only to corporations) and the Building Register through the joint use of administrative information pursuant to Article 36 , Paragraph 1 of the Electronic Government Act . <Amended Jan. 15, 2008; Aug. 17, 2010; Jun. 19, 2014; Jul. 22, 2014>

rows.source_ko: ③제1항에 따라 신고를 받은 특별자치시장ㆍ특별자치도지사ㆍ시장ㆍ군수ㆍ구청장은 별지 제5호서식의 한부모가족복지시설 설치신고 확인증을 신고인에게 교부하여야 한다. <개정 2008. 1. 15., 2010. 8. 17., 2014. 7. 22.>
rows.text_en: ③ The Mayor of a Special Self-Governing City, the Governor of a Special Self-Governing Province, a Mayor, a County Governor, or a District Head who receives a report pursuant to Paragraph 1 shall issue a Confirmation Certificate of Report on the Establishment of a Single-Parent Family Welfare Facility in the form of Attached Form No. 5 to the reporter. <Amended Jan. 15, 2008; Aug. 17, 2010; Jul. 22, 2014>

rows.source_ko: ④제1항에 따라 한부모가족복지시설을 설치ㆍ운영하는 자는 한부모가족복지시설의 대표자(법인이 설치한 시설의 경우만 해당한다) 또는 시설의 장, 시설의 종류ㆍ명칭ㆍ소재지 또는 입소정원을 변경하려는 경우에는 별지 제6호서식의 한부모가족복지시설 변경신고서(전자문서로 된 신고서를 포함한다. 이하 같다)에 다음 각 호의 서류를 첨부하여 특별자치시장ㆍ특별자치도지사ㆍ시장ㆍ군수ㆍ구청장에게 제출하여야 한다. <개정 2008. 1. 15., 2010. 8. 17., 2014. 7. 22., 2016. 9. 7.>
rows.text_en: ④ If a person establishing and operating a welfare facility for single-parent families pursuant to Paragraph 1 intends to change the representative of the welfare facility for single-parent families (only applicable in the case of a facility established by a corporation), the head of the facility, or the type, name, location, or admission capacity of the facility, they shall submit a Notification of Change of Welfare Facility for Single-Parent Families in the form of Attached Form No. 6 (including a notification in the form of an electronic document; hereinafter the same applies) to the Mayor of a Special Self-Governing City, the Governor of a Special Self-Governing Province, a Mayor, a County Head, or a District Head, attaching the documents specified in each of the following subparagraphs. <Amended Jan. 15, 2008; Aug. 17, 2010; Jul. 22, 2014; Sep. 7, 2016>

rows.source_ko: 1. 법인의 이사회 회의록(법인의 대표자가 변경된 경우에 한한다)
rows.text_en: 1. Minutes of the Board of Directors meeting of the corporation (limited to cases where the representative of the corporation has changed)

rows.source_ko: 2. 변경시설의 평면도(소재지 또는 입소정원의 변경 등으로 시설의 변경이 있는 경우에 한한다)
rows.text_en: 2. Floor plan of the modified facility (limited to cases where there are changes to the facility, such as changes in location or occupancy capacity)

rows.source_ko: 3. 한부모가족복지시설의 장의 자격을 증명하는 서류(한부모가족복지시설의 장의 자격이 변경된 경우에 한한다)
rows.text_en: 3. Documents proving the qualifications of the head of the single-parent family welfare facility (limited to cases where the qualifications of the head of the single-parent family welfare facility have changed)

rows.source_ko: 4. 시설 및 재산에 관한 사용ㆍ처분계획서(소재지가 변경되는 경우에 한한다)
rows.text_en: 4. Plan for use and disposal of facilities and property (only applicable in cases where the location changes)

rows.source_ko: 5. 한부모가족복지시설 입소자에 대한 조치계획서(소재지 또는 입소정원이 변경되는 경우에 한한다)
rows.text_en: 5. Action plan for residents of single-parent family welfare facilities (limited to cases where the location or admission quota changes)

rows.source_ko: 6. 한부모가족복지시설 설치신고 확인증
rows.text_en: 6. Confirmation of Report on Establishment of Single-Parent Family Welfare Facility

rows.source_ko: ⑤제4항에 따라 변경신고서를 제출받은 담당공무원은 「전자정부법」 제36조제1항에 따른 행정정보의 공동이용을 통하여 건축물대장(소재지 또는 입소정원의 변경 등으로 시설의 변경이 있는 경우에 한한다)을 확인하여야 한다. <개정 2008. 1. 15., 2010. 8. 17.>
rows.text_en: ⑤ The public official in charge who receives a report of change pursuant to Paragraph 4 shall verify the building register (limited to cases where there is a change in the facility, such as a change in location or occupancy capacity), through the joint use of administrative information pursuant to Article 36, Paragraph 1 of the Electronic Government Act. <Amended Jan. 15, 2008; Aug. 17, 2010>

rows.source_ko: ⑥특별자치시장ㆍ특별자치도지사ㆍ시장ㆍ군수ㆍ구청장은 제3항에 따라 한부모가족복지시설 설치신고 확인증을 교부하거나 제4항에 따라 한부모가족복지시설 변경신고를 받은 때에는 그 때부터 15일 이내에 시ㆍ도지사를 거쳐 성평등가족부장관에게 보고하여야 한다. 다만, 특별자치시ㆍ특별자치도의 경우에는 특별자치시장ㆍ특별자치도지사가 직접 성평등가족부장관에게 보고하여야 한다. <개정 2008. 1. 15., 2008. 3. 3., 2010. 3. 19., 2010. 8. 17., 2014. 7. 22., 2025. 10. 1.>
rows.text_en: ⑥ When a Mayor of a Special Self-Governing City, a Governor of a Special Self-Governing Province, a Mayor, a County Head, or a District Head issues a confirmation certificate for the installation of a single-parent family welfare facility pursuant to Paragraph 3, or receives a report on the change of a single-parent family welfare facility pursuant to Paragraph 4, they shall report to the Minister of Gender Equality and Family through the Governor of the City or Province within 15 days from that time. However, in the case of a Special Self-Governing City or a Special Self-Governing Province, the Mayor of the Special Self-Governing City or the Governor of the Special Self-Governing Province shall report directly to the Minister of Gender Equality and Family. <Amended Jan. 15, 2008; Mar. 3, 2008; Mar. 19, 2010; Aug. 17, 2010; Jul. 22, 2014; Oct. 1, 2025>

[Wholly Amended Mar. 29, 2007]
[Title Amended Jan. 15, 2008]

rows.source_ko: 제10조의2(한부모가족복지시설의 설치기준 등) ①법 제20조제6항에 따른 한부모가족복지시설의 설치기준은 별표 2와 같다. <개정 2008. 1. 15., 2012. 1. 2., 2023. 3. 23.>
rows.text_en: Article 10-2 (Standards for Installation of Welfare Facilities for Single-Parent Families, etc.) ① The standards for installation of welfare facilities for single-parent families pursuant to Article 20 , Paragraph 6 of the Act are as set forth in Attached Table 2. <Amended Jan. 15, 2008; Jan. 2, 2012; Mar. 23, 2023>

rows.source_ko: ②법 제20조제6항에 따라 한부모가족복지시설에 두어야 할 종사자의 직종과 수 및 자격기준은 각각 별표 3 및 별표 4와 같다. 다만, 지역 내에 별표 4에 따른 종사자의 자격기준을 충족하는 사람이 부족한 경우 등 부득이한 경우에는 특별자치시ㆍ특별자치도ㆍ시ㆍ군ㆍ구의 조례로 정하는 바에 따라 그 기준을 완화할 수 있다. <개정 2008. 1. 15., 2012. 1. 2., 2014. 12. 12., 2023. 3. 23.>
rows.text_en: ② Pursuant to Article 20, Paragraph 6 of the Act , the job types, number, and qualification standards for employees to be employed at single-parent family welfare facilities shall be as set forth in Attached Tables 3 and 4 , respectively . However, in unavoidable circumstances, such as a shortage of persons within the region who meet the qualification standards for employees set forth in Attached Table 4 , such standards may be relaxed as prescribed by the ordinances of the Special Self-Governing City, Special Self-Governing Province, City, County, or District . <Amended Jan. 15, 2008; Jan. 2, 2012; Dec. 12, 2014; Mar. 23, 2023>

[This Article was newly established on Mar. 29, 2007.]
[Title amended on Jan. 15, 2008.]

rows.source_ko: 제11조(한부모가족복지시설의 폐지ㆍ운영중단 등 신고) ①법 제21조에 따라 한부모가족복지시설을 폐지 또는 운영중단(운영중단기간은 1년 이내로 한정한다)하거나 운영을 재개하려는 자는 폐지ㆍ운영중단ㆍ재개 3개월 전까지 별지 제7호서식의 한부모가족복지시설 폐지(운영중단ㆍ재개)신고서(전자문서로 된 신고서를 포함한다)에 다음 각 호의 서류를 첨부하여 특별자치시장ㆍ특별자치도지사ㆍ시장ㆍ군수ㆍ구청장에게 제출하여야 하며, 이를 시설종사자 및 입소자에게 알려주어야 한다. <개정 2008. 1. 15., 2010. 8. 17., 2014. 7. 22., 2016. 9. 7., 2019. 8. 28.>
rows.text_en: Article 11 (Reporting of Closure, Suspension of Operation, etc. of Single-Parent Family Welfare Facilities) ① Any person who intends to close or suspend the operation of a single-parent family welfare facility (the suspension period shall be limited to within one year) or to resume its operation pursuant to Article 21 of the Act shall submit a Report on Closure (Suspension/Resumption of Operation) of a Single-Parent Family Welfare Facility in the form of Attached Form No. 7 (including a report in the form of an electronic document) to the Mayor of a Special Self-Governing City, the Governor of a Special Self-Governing Province, a Mayor, a County Head, or a District Head, attaching the documents specified in each of the following subparagraphs, no later than three months prior to the closure, suspension, or resumption of operation, and shall notify the facility staff and residents thereof. <Amended Jan. 15, 2008; Aug. 17, 2010; Jul. 22, 2014; Sep. 7, 2016; Aug. 28, 2019>

rows.source_ko: 1. 한부모가족복지시설의 폐지ㆍ운영중단 또는 재개사유서(법인인 경우에는 폐지ㆍ운영중단 또는 재개를 결의한 이사회의 회의록 사본) 1부
rows.text_en: 1. Statement of reasons for closure, suspension of operation, or resumption of the single-parent family welfare facility (in the case of a corporation, a copy of the minutes of the board meeting resolving the closure, suspension of operation, or resumption) 1 copy

rows.source_ko: 2. 한부모가족복지시설의 입소자에 대한 조치계획서(폐지 또는 운영중단하는 경우만 해당한다) 1부
rows.text_en: 2. One copy of the action plan for residents of single-parent family welfare facilities (applicable only in cases of closure or suspension of operation).

rows.source_ko: 3. 보조금ㆍ후원금의 사용 결과 보고서와 이를 재원으로 조성한 잔여재산 반환조치계획서(폐지 또는 운영중단하는 경우만 해당한다) 1부
rows.text_en: 3. One copy of the report on the use of subsidies and sponsorships and the plan for the return of remaining assets raised from such funds (applicable only in cases of abolition or suspension of operations).

rows.source_ko: 4. 한부모가족복지시설의 재산에 관한 사용 또는 처분계획서(폐지 또는 운영중단하는 경우만 해당한다) 1부
rows.text_en: 4. One copy of the plan for the use or disposal of the property of the single-parent family welfare facility (applicable only in cases of closure or suspension of operation).

rows.source_ko: 5. 한부모가족복지시설 설치신고 확인증(폐지하는 경우만 해당한다) 1부
rows.text_en: 5. One copy of the Certificate of Confirmation for the Establishment of a Single-Parent Family Welfare Facility (applicable only in case of closure).

rows.source_ko: ② 제1항에 따라 신고서를 제출받은 특별자치시장ㆍ특별자치도지사ㆍ시장ㆍ군수ㆍ구청장은 제1항에 따라 제출된 계획서에 따른 조치가 이루어지는지를 확인하여야 한다. <신설 2016. 9. 7.>
rows.text_en: ② The Mayor of a Special Self-Governing City, the Governor of a Special Self-Governing Province, a Mayor, a County Governor, or a District Head who has received a report pursuant to Paragraph 1 shall verify whether measures in accordance with the plan submitted pursuant to Paragraph 1 are being taken. <Newly added Sep. 7, 2016>

rows.source_ko: ③특별자치시장ㆍ특별자치도지사ㆍ시장ㆍ군수ㆍ구청장이 제1항에 따른 폐지(운영중단ㆍ재개)신고서를 수리한 경우에는 그 때부터 15일 이내에 시ㆍ도지사를 거쳐 성평등가족부장관에게 보고하여야 한다. 다만, 특별자치시ㆍ특별자치도의 경우에는 특별자치시장ㆍ특별자치도지사가 직접 성평등가족부장관에게 보고하여야 한다. <개정 2008. 3. 3., 2010. 3. 19., 2010. 8. 17., 2014. 7. 22., 2016. 9. 7., 2019. 8. 28., 2025. 10. 1.>
rows.text_en: ③ Where the Mayor of a Special Self-Governing City, the Governor of a Special Self-Governing Province, a Mayor, a County Head, or a District Head accepts a report of abolition (suspension of operation/resumption of operation) pursuant to Paragraph 1, they shall report to the Minister of Gender Equality and Family through the City/Provincial Governor within 15 days from that time. However, in the case of a Special Self-Governing City or a Special Self-Governing Province, the Mayor of the Special Self-Governing City or the Governor of the Special Self-Governing Province shall report directly to the Minister of Gender Equality and Family. <Amended Mar. 3, 2008; Mar. 19, 2010; Aug. 17, 2010; Jul. 22, 2014; Sep. 7, 2016; Aug. 28, 2019; Oct. 1, 2025>

[Wholly Amended Mar. 29, 2007]
[Title Amended Jan. 15, 2008, Aug. 28, 2019]

rows.source_ko: 제11조의2(한부모가족복지시설의 평가) ① 시ㆍ도지사 및 「건강가정기본법」 제34조의2에 따라 설립된 한국건강가정진흥원(이하 “한국건강가정진흥원”이라 한다)은 법 제23조의2제1항에 따른 한부모가족복지시설의 평가(이하 이 조 및 제11조의3에서 “평가”라 한다)를 3년마다 현장평가 및 확인평가 등의 방법으로 실시해야 한다.
rows.text_en: Article 11-2 (Evaluation of Welfare Facilities for Single-Parent Families) ① The mayors and governors of cities and provinces and the Korea Institute for Healthy Families established pursuant to Article 34-2 of the Framework Act on Healthy Families (hereinafter referred to as the “Korea Institute for Healthy Families”) shall conduct an evaluation of welfare facilities for single-parent families pursuant to Article 23-2, Paragraph 1 of the Act (hereinafter referred to as “evaluation” in this Article and Article 11-3 ) every three years by methods such as on-site evaluation and verification evaluation.

rows.source_ko: ② 시ㆍ도지사 및 한국건강가정진흥원은 객관적인 평가를 위하여 평가지표를 정하고 이에 따라 평가를 실시해야 한다. 이 경우 평가지표에는 한부모가족복지시설의 환경, 입소자의 권리 등에 관한 사항이 포함되어야 한다.
rows.text_en: ② The Mayors and Governors of Cities and Provinces and the Korea Institute for Healthy Family Promotion shall establish evaluation indicators for objective evaluation and conduct evaluations accordingly. In this case, the evaluation indicators shall include matters concerning the environment of single-parent family welfare facilities and the rights of residents.

rows.source_ko: ③ 제1항 및 제2항에 따른 평가의 방법 및 지표 등 평가에 필요한 구체적인 사항은 한국건강가정진흥원이 성평등가족부장관의 승인을 받아 정한다. <개정 2025. 10. 1.>
rows.text_en: ③ Specific matters necessary for the evaluation, such as evaluation methods and indicators pursuant to Paragraphs 1 and 2, shall be determined by the Korea Institute for Healthy Family upon the approval of the Minister of Gender Equality and Family. <Amended Oct. 1, 2025>

[This Article was newly added on June 4, 2025.]
[Formerly Article 11-2 was moved to Article 11-4 <June 4, 2025>]

rows.source_ko: 제11조의3(평가 결과의 공표) 성평등가족부장관 및 시ㆍ도지사는 법 제23조의2제1항에 따라 평가 결과를 공표하는 경우에는 해당 기관의 인터넷 홈페이지에 게시해야 한다. <개정 2025. 10. 1.>
rows.text_en: Article 11-3 (Publication of Evaluation Results) When the Minister of Gender Equality and Family and city and provincial mayors and governors publish evaluation results pursuant to Article 23-2, Paragraph 1 of the Act , they shall post them on the internet homepage of the relevant agency. <Amended Oct. 1, 2025>
[This Article Newly Inserted June 4, 2025]

rows.source_ko: 제11조의4(시설 폐쇄 등에 따른 조치) 특별자치시장ㆍ특별자치도지사ㆍ시장ㆍ군수ㆍ구청장은 법 제24조제2항에 따라 한부모가족복지시설의 사업이 정지 또는 폐지되거나 시설이 폐쇄되는 경우에는 다음 각 호에 따른 조치를 하여야 한다.
rows.text_en: Article 11-4 (Measures due to closure of facilities, etc.) In the event that the business of a single-parent family welfare facility is suspended or abolished, or the facility is closed pursuant to Article 24, Paragraph 2 of the Act , the Mayor of a Special Self-Governing City, the Governor of a Special Self-Governing Province, a Mayor, a County Governor, or a District Head shall take measures in accordance with each of the following subparagraphs.

rows.source_ko: 1. 시설 입소자가 다른 시설을 선택할 수 있도록 하고 그 이행을 확인하는 조치
rows.text_en: 1. Measures to allow residents to choose another facility and to verify compliance.

rows.source_ko: 2. 보조금ㆍ후원금의 사용 실태 확인과 이를 재원으로 조성한 재산 중 남은 재산의 회수조치
rows.text_en: 2. Verification of the usage status of subsidies and sponsorships, and measures to recover remaining assets among those raised using these funds

rows.source_ko: 3. 그 밖에 시설 입소자의 권익 보호를 위하여 필요하다고 인정되는 조치
rows.text_en: 3. Other measures deemed necessary for the protection of the rights and interests of facility residents

[This Article was newly added on Sep. 7, 2016]
[Moved from Article 11-2 <June 4, 2025>]

rows.source_ko: 제12조(서식) 영 제12조제2항 및 이 규칙 제9조의3제1항에 따른 복지 급여 신청서, 소득ㆍ재산 신고서 및 금융정보등 제공 동의서, 영 제12조제4항에 따른 통지, 제5조제1항에 따른 복지대상자 통합관리카드, 제8조제1항에 따른 복지자금대여신청서, 제8조제3항에 따른 복지대상자자금대여결정통지서, 제9조에 따른 복지대상자 자금대여관리카드 및 제9조의4제1항에 따른 복지대상자 시설입소 신청서는 사회복지관련 사업 및 서비스와 관련하여 보건복지부장관이 정하여 고시하는 공통서식에 따른다. <개정 2010. 3. 19., 2010. 8. 17., 2012. 1. 2., 2012. 8. 2., 2014. 7. 22.>
rows.text_en: Article 12 (Forms) Applications for welfare benefits pursuant to Article 12, Paragraph 2 of the Enforcement Decree and Article 9-3, Paragraph 1 of these Rules, declarations of income and assets and consent forms for the provision of financial information, etc., notices pursuant to Article 12 , Paragraph 4 of the Enforcement Decree, integrated management cards for welfare recipients pursuant to Article 5 , Paragraph 1 , applications for welfare fund loans pursuant to Article 8 , Paragraph 1 , notices of decision on welfare fund loans pursuant to Article 8, Paragraph 3 , fund loan management cards for welfare recipients pursuant to Article 9 , and applications for admission to facilities for welfare recipients pursuant to Article 9-4, Paragraph 1 shall be in accordance with the common forms prescribed and notified by the Minister of Health and Welfare in relation to social welfare-related projects and services. <Amended Mar. 19, 2010; Aug. 17, 2010; Jan. 2, 2012; Aug. 2, 2012; Jul. 22, 2014>
[Wholly Amended Dec. 31, 2009]

rows.source_ko: 제13조(규제의 재검토) 성평등가족부장관은 다음 각 호의 사항에 대하여 2025년 1월 1일을 기준으로 3년마다(매 3년이 되는 해의 기준일과 같은 날 전까지를 말한다) 그 타당성을 검토하여 개선 등의 조치를 하여야 한다. <개정 2018. 6. 12., 2025. 6. 4., 2025. 10. 1.>
rows.text_en: Article 13 (Review of Regulations) The Minister of Gender Equality and Family shall review the validity of the matters set forth in each of the following subparagraphs every three years, starting from January 1, 2025 (meaning the period prior to the same date as the reference date of every third year), and take measures such as improvements. <Amended Jun. 12, 2018; Jun. 4, 2025; Oct. 1, 2025>
1. Deleted <June 4, 2025>

rows.text_en: 3. Job types and number of employees at single-parent family welfare facilities pursuant to Article 10-2 , Paragraph 2 and Annex 3
